Valuation: cash is scored at 1.00 cents per point ($1.00 cash = 100 points-equivalent). Points and cash are ranked on this single yardstick.

Data problems flagged, NOT silently fixed
  - HOTEL DATES DO NOT LINE UP WITH THE FLIGHTS. Novotel Madrid and NH City Centre Amsterdam are BOTH booked Jan 15-19 2027, which is impossible - you cannot be in two cities on the same 
four nights. The flight legs imply Madrid ~Jan 16-19, Amsterdam Jan 19-23, London Jan 23-27. Reported, NOT corrected: the right dates are a decision for Tsuki, not a guess for the optimizer.
  - Trip A and Trip B both start Jan 15 2027. They appear to be ALTERNATIVES, not one itinerary. Scored separately.
  - Flights are priced for 1 adult, hotels for 2 people. Nothing has been doubled to reconcile this.
  - No London hotel dates were given beyond '4 nights'. Assumed to be the Jan 23-27 window implied by the flights, but the booking dates were not captured.
  - Every Google 'from $X' headline in this capture is LOWER than the cheapest option actually listed beneath it (388 vs 395, 35 vs 44, 450 vs 482). The headline fares were not available in 
the listing; the listed fares are used.

must not be quoted as one. Per-leg results above are unaffected and remain valid. Re-run without --require-all-live to see the mixed-provenance number, clearly labelled as mixed.
